E.headline: Cross-domain mapping raised originality for humans but gave LLMs no overall benefit; LLMs were more original than humans, and only top LLMs gained from distant sources.

G.notes: LLM prompts, temperature, snapshots, dates and number of draws not given in the text read (Supplement not in the markdown); per-model effects only in Fig 2. o3 rephrased all ideas and was also a subject. First-author coded structure transfer alone (no reliability). Preregistration covers the rating study.
